## Load Packages
```{r message = FALSE}
package.list = c("ggplot2","tidyr", "ggridges",
                 "patchwork")
  sapply(package.list, function(package){
  if(!require(package, character.only = TRUE)){
  install.packages(package, dependencies = TRUE)
} 
  library(package, character.only = TRUE)
})
```

## Local Metrics Plots

#### Strength (Redundancy) |Psych Version|

```{r}

# Data frame with strength deltas (Redundant - True)
sdeltas <- data.frame(
  Strength = local_metrics[, (nv + 1):(2*nv), "Strength"] - local_metrics[, 1:nv, "Strength"],
  Strength.wo = local_metrics[, (nv + 1):(2*nv), "Strength w/o Clone"] - local_metrics[, 1:nv, "Strength w/o Clone"]
)

# Rename columns of data frame
colnames(sdeltas) <- c(paste0("P", 1:(nv-1)), "Target", paste0("P", 1:(nv-1), ".wo"), "Target.wo")

# Convert to long data frame
sdeltas.long <- pivot_longer(sdeltas, cols = c(paste0("P", 1:(nv-1)), "Target", paste0("P", 1:(nv-1), ".wo"), "Target.wo"))

# Rename columns of long data frame
colnames(sdeltas.long) <- c("Node", "Strength.Delta")

# Factor variable "Node"
sdeltas.long$Node = factor(sdeltas.long$Node, levels = c(paste0("P", 1:(nv-1)), "Target", paste0("P", 1:(nv-1), ".wo"), "Target.wo"))

# Use tapply() to obtain measures of central tendency
mean.sdeltas = tapply(X = sdeltas.long$Strength.Delta, INDEX = sdeltas.long$Node, FUN = mean)
sd.sdeltas = tapply(X = sdeltas.long$Strength.Delta, INDEX = sdeltas.long$Node,FUN = sd)


# Data frame ready for ggplot 
sdeltas.gg <- data.frame(
  Node = names(mean.sdeltas),
  Mean = as.vector(mean.sdeltas),
  SE = (as.vector(sd.sdeltas))/sqrt(1000))

# Add grouping column for fill and color

sdeltas.gg$Type = c(rep("With Clone", nv), rep("Without Clone", nv))

# Match using gsub() any node that ends with ".wo" and remove for ggplot

sdeltas.gg$Node = gsub("\\.wo$", "", sdeltas.gg$Node)

# Plot using ggplot2

jpeg("/Users/abraham/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Redundancy_Project/Output/Delta Strength Plot (Redundancy).jpg",
     width= 12,
     height= 6,
     res=800,
     units="in")
ggplot(sdeltas.gg, aes(x = Node, y = Mean, shape = Node)) +
  geom_point(size = 5, aes(fill = Type, color = Type), 
             alpha = .8, show.legend = TRUE) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("P1" = 21, "P2" = 22, "P3" = 23, "Target" = 24)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Mean - SE, ymax = Mean + SE), linewidth = .25, width = .15) +
  ylim(-.5, .5) +
  labs(x = "Node",
       y = expression(paste(Delta, " Strength"))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0,
             linetype = 2,
             color = "red") +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right",
        legend.direction = "vertical",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.background = element_rect(color = "lightgrey"),
        legend.spacing.y = unit(1, "cm")) +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE),
         shape = guide_legend(byrow = TRUE,
                              override.aes = list(size = 4)))
dev.off()
```

## Global Metrics

### Weighted Density

```{r}
# Convenience
common_theme = theme(
  axis.title.y = element_blank(), 
  axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),  
  plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),   
  legend.position = "right",        
  legend.box = "vertical",
  legend.justification = "center"   
)

## Redundant network

ggWD = data.frame(
  True.Network = global_metrics[,1,"Weighted Density"],
  Redundant.Network = global_metrics[,2,"Weighted Density"],
  Redundant.Network.Without.Clone = global_metrics[,3,"Weighted Density"])

stacked_WD = stack(x = ggWD, select = c("True.Network", "Redundant.Network", "Redundant.Network.Without.Clone"))

# Basic density ridge plot

# ggplot(stacked_df, aes(x = values,
#                        y = ind,
#                        fill = ind)) +
#   geom_density_ridges(quantile_lines = TRUE,
#                       quantiles = c(0.025, 0.975),
#                       alpha = 0.7) +
#   theme_minimal()

# Quartile ridgeline plot
p1 = ggplot(stacked_WD, aes(x = values,
                       y = ind,
                       fill = factor(stat(quantile)))) +
  stat_density_ridges(geom = "density_ridges_gradient",
                             calc_ecdf = TRUE,
                             quantiles = 4,
                             quantile_lines = TRUE) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Quartiles") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("True Network",
                              "Redundant Network",
                              "Redundant Network w/o Clone")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.1,.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Network",
       title = "Weighted Density Ridgeline Plot") + 
  common_theme


# Jitter ridgeline plot
p3 = ggplot(stacked_WD, aes(x = values,
                       y = ind,
                       fill = ind)) +
  geom_density_ridges(aes(point_color = ind,
        point_fill = ind,
        point_shape = ind),
        alpha = .2,
        point_alpha = 1,
        jittered_points = TRUE) +
  scale_point_color_hue(l = 40) +
  scale_discrete_manual(aesthetics = "point_shape", values = c(21, 22, 23)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("True Network",
                              "Redundant Network",
                              "Redudant Network w/o Clone")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.1,.5)) +
  labs(x = NULL,
       y = "Network",
       title = "Weighted Density Ridgeline Plot") +
  common_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")




## Random Network

ggWD.random = data.frame(
  True.Network = global_metrics_random[,1,"Weighted Density"],
  Random.Network = global_metrics_random[,2,"Weighted Density"],
  Random.Network.Without.Random = global_metrics_random[,3,"Weighted Density"])

stacked_WD_random = stack(x = ggWD.random, select = c("True.Network", "Random.Network", "Random.Network.Without.Random"))

# Quartile ridgeline plot
p2  = ggplot(stacked_WD_random, aes(x = values,
                       y = ind,
                       fill = factor(stat(quantile)))) +
  stat_density_ridges(geom = "density_ridges_gradient",
                             calc_ecdf = TRUE,
                             quantiles = 4,
                             quantile_lines = TRUE) + 
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Quartiles") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("True Network",
                              "Random Network",
                              "Random Network w/o additional node")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.1,.5)) +
  labs(x = "Weighted Density",
       y = "Network") +
  common_theme

# Jitter ridgeline plot

p4 = ggplot(stacked_WD_random, aes(x = values,
                       y = ind,
                       fill = ind)) +
  geom_density_ridges(aes(point_color = ind,
        point_fill = ind,
        point_shape = ind),
        alpha = .2,
        point_alpha = 1,
        jittered_points = TRUE) +
  scale_point_color_hue(l = 40) +
  scale_discrete_manual(aesthetics = "point_shape", values = c(21, 22, 23)) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.1,.5)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c("True Network",
                              "Random Network",
                              "Random Network w/o additional node")) +
  labs(x = "Weighted Density",
       y = "Network") +
  common_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

```
